name: mobile_list_remote_devices
description: List the catalog of device models (make, platform, OS version) available to reserve from the remote cloud device fleet. This is different from mobile_list_available_devices, which lists real devices and simulators/emulators already connected to this local machine and ready to use immediately at no cost. Remote devices live in a shared cloud fleet: they are not usable until reserved with mobile_allocate_remote_device, and reserving one may be a limited/billed resource. Requires mobile_login_to_cloud_provider to have been called first; if this fails with an authentication error, call that tool then retry.
